errors.evidence: The description claims the labels are written inside the segments, but they are all located outside the pie chart, next to their corresponding slices.
There is a spelling error in the word "Пяттият". The correct word for "The fifth" in Bulgarian is "Петият".

errors.text_span: Секторите са разположени във визуален ред по низходящ размер, започвайки от най-големия (оранжев и жълт, по 35%) и завършвайки с най-малкия (сив, 4%).
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the sectors are arranged in descending order of size. The actual order of slices, when viewed clockwise, corresponds to percentages of 17%, 35%, 4%, 35%, and 9%, which is not a descending sequence.

errors.text_span: а всички етикети са разположени директно вътре в съответните сектори
errors.evidence: This is a repetition of a previous error, stating that the labels are inside the sectors, when they are clearly positioned outside the pie chart.
